messages:
Maya: Quick design check — proposing we standardize on inline validation for the bulk-edit form + a compact top-of-form summary for destructive actions. Thinking this reduces scan time for people editing many rows. Thoughts? Jon: Inline for field-level fixes yes. For bulk actions we still need a top summary that lists the rows with errors and keeps the primary CTA disabled until fixes. Otherwise folks will be confused why nothing happens. Alex: Agree with Jon. Inline errors should be concise (1 line) with a link to 'Show row' for collapsed rows. For required markers: asterisk alone is ambiguous; use both a visible '*' and an SR-only 'required' text. Also add aria-required on inputs. Sam: Accessibility nits: make sure inline errors are announced. Use role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" for the first visible error and shift focus to first invalid field on submit. For bulk submits, announce "X rows have errors" and provide a keyboard-focusable list. :accessibility: Aria: Microcopy nit — instead of repeating "This field is required" for every field, switch to context-sensitive phrasing where helpful: e.g., "Enter a project name" or "Select a pipeline". Also, for destructive confirms: typed-confirm is great for irreversible actions, but it's heavy for common bulk deletes. Maya: Yeah — proposal: soft-delete flow uses a clear modal + undo toast. Typed-confirm reserved for full purges or deletes > N items (we can decide N). For bulk deletes between small and purge, show a prominent modal with checkbox "I understand this cannot be undone" + primary CTA disabled until checked. Alex: Mockup snippet for label + announcement (rough): ```html
3 rows have errors. Use the list below to jump to each error.
``` Jon: :thumbsup: Love the checkbox compromise for mid-size bulk deletes. Also: show estimated undo retention time in the modal (e.g., "undo available for 30s"). Sam: Test cases to add: keyboard-only deletion flow, screen-reader announce of error summary, focus management on submit, row-collapsed error linking. I'll write them up. Aria: Copy nits — avoid scary language like "This action cannot be undone" without context. Prefer: "This will permanently remove X items from this workspace. You can restore within 30s via undo." Save typed-confirm for permanent purge. design-bot: Updated Figma frame: https://figma.company/board/bulk-delete-v2 (thumbnail added). Also added the new a11y checklist to the spec doc. Maya: Action items: 1) Alex — update Figma with inline-error variants + top summary pattern; 2) Sam — a11y test cases; 3) Aria — copy pass for modals and toast; 4) Jon — decide threshold number for typed-confirm and confirm with PM. I'll run this in design review Thurs. Jon: OK will get numbers from analytics and post before Thurs. Alex: I'll add the code examples and the collapsed-row behavior notes. Sam: I'll slot test cases in the sprint. Maya: Thanks all :heart:
